title: Chapter 246 Reception
content:
Chapter 246 Reception

Therefore, when the Mohist peasant family arrived at home, the three parties, their joint leaders, reached a consensus.

Xiaoyaozi and the others finally stood up, finished their meditation practice, adjusted their clothes a little, and spoke loudly to the cavalry commander outside the tent.

"It's really disappointing. The poor Daoists are just now cultivating, and it's hard to reap their merits for a while. I hope you will forgive me for my negligence!"

Hearing the voice from the tent, and the faint explanation and apology in the voice, the cavalry commander who had been bowing his head and waiting for an answer finally showed a smile on his serious and respectful face. Nodding his head, he was very satisfied with the acquaintance of those people inside and how they accepted as soon as they were good.

Although the cavalry commander also understands that his master recruited those people here, directly guarded them for three days, and treated them, the masters of each school, as prisoners, and took care of them first. This is very rude. .

But so what, his master is supreme, and his orders are everything, not to mention these mere rivers and lakes, the masters of a school of thought. Even if it is the king of that country, as long as his master has an order, then the cavalry commander will follow suit.

The curtain of the tent in front of him was pulled up suddenly, and the dazzling sunlight shone into the closed tent, making the somewhat dark space bright.

Xiaoyaozi was dressed in a white and purple Taoist robe, followed by Tian Guang, who was also tall and majestic, and old man Ban, who was short and tall with white hair, walked out together

Seeing his target, that is, the current leaders of the three schools came out, the cavalry commander bowed down again.

"My lords, I have been negligent these few days. Please forgive me. The military is really busy and I can't get away for a while. I hope you don't care!"

How could Xiaoyaozi dare to trust him, now that he is in the enemy's camp, his own safety is beyond his control. If it is really so unscrupulous, even if they are the masters of a school, they have the power to influence the entire world. It's hard to guarantee that they won't be smashed here, and the leader of the coalition army will take the risk and directly wipe out.

Suddenly accepting this big gift again, Xiaoyaozi really couldn't trust him, so he hurriedly stepped forward to support the commander, and said:

"My lord is serious. I am in an expensive place, and many things are still unclear. I hope my lord will support me a lot and take care of me!"

The commander also took advantage of the situation to get up, he didn't want to do this at first, but he had no choice but to do so because his master cared about him before leaving.

The two sides exchanged polite words, but the commander didn't want to continue. He had delayed for a long time just now, and had already missed the king's order. If he continued to delay, his master would probably blame him.

"Since your lords have finished their preparations, please leave with your general. Your majesty has been waiting for a long time. If you delay, I'm afraid it will cause your majesty's dissatisfaction!"

Xiaoyaozi and the others also looked serious when they heard the words, and once again tidied up their luggage, and after confirming that there was nothing missing, they said: "Then let's go, it's rude to keep the king waiting for a long time!"

In fact, I can't blame Xiaoyao himself, people are too spineless, it is really the background of this era.

Even if people like Xiaoyaozi are the masters of a school, they are themselves a group of people standing at the top of the world. But facing the kings of various countries, they still had to bow their proud backs and bow their heads to those kings who are above them.

The development of each school depends on the support of various countries, so that their theories can be spread. Otherwise, the resistance of some countries, even if the theory will not be cut off, will only hide in the ground and become a shady mouse.

Just like Zhuangzi, Mencius, and Huizi, these top figures of various schools, who were admired and preached by countless people in later generations, had to travel in the palaces of various countries to spread their own theories.

You know, the cultivation base of these people is much stronger than the current Donghuang Taiyi, and some people have even broken through the limitations of countless masters in this era, reaching the legendary fifth level.

But they are so powerful, because of various interests and balances, and facing the order of this era, they have to continue to promote their respective theories for the kings of the countries with mediocre strength and ordinary wisdom. This won the appreciation of those kings.

Then people like Xiaoyaozi today are not so surprised that they are so solemn about the upcoming meeting with Prince Jing.

"Since everyone is ready, please follow me. I have prepared mounts for you!" The commander led Xiaoyaozi and the three to the healthy horses he had prepared, and instructed them.

Why prepare a horse? Naturally, the journey is long.

After all, it was a military camp of 100,000 people, and there were a total of 350,000 people stationed there before. Naturally, it is impossible for such a large number of people to gather in such a small area, but it stretches for more than 20 miles.

Although Xiaoyaozi's place of detention is also in the center of the military camp, it is still five or six miles away from the most central Zhongyu Camp.

If he walked such a long distance, it would take him more than half an hour. As for using the lightness kung fu to go all the way, it would be even more ridiculous.

In a place where the military camp is important, they are not allowed to be presumptuous, let alone meeting the commander of the imperial kingdom, and now His Royal Highness Prince Jing, their behavior can be said to be disrespectful and offensive.

So how many horses are ready? But it was a reasonable arrangement, extremely considerate.

"So, thank you General for your kindness!" Xiaoyaozi and others, as the leaders of a school, naturally would not lack such a little political wisdom. After a little thought, they understood the truth, smiled, and thanked the leader in front of him.

The sound of horseshoes sounded, Xiaoyaozi and the others also followed the leader in front of him, and after so long, the leader was still very anxious.

For the king's order, the people under him are trying to solve it with the idea of being as perfect as possible. This time, the pick-up matter is arranged on his head. Among the many commanders under his command, he showed his face.

Fortunately, the king left an impression in his heart that he would not forget himself when he had the opportunity to be promoted in the future.

But now that it has been delayed for so long, I don't know if I will feel guilty at night. If I didn't make a contribution, but caused a mess, it would be a big shame.

So the commander kept waving his horsewhip along the way, forcing himself to sit down in the one-in-a-million BMW and head towards the big tent of the Chinese army.

Xiaoyaozi and the others behind them looked at each other, obviously seeing the commander's anxiety, smiled, and took their breath away.

Then he also drove the horses and followed them. After all, they also really wanted to meet this Prince Jing who had imprisoned them for a long time.
